_comment: SEEDED ICD-10-CM -> CMS-HCC classification crosswalk (data-is-not-code). Maps a diagnosis code to its HCC group under a SPECIFIC, versioned model. This is a stub demo mapping, NOT the full licensed CMS HCC crosswalk. `model` names the family + registry asset id + version this content represents, so a classification carries WHICH model version grouped the code. An unmapped diagnosis returns NO group (never a fabricated group).

E11.9.label: Diabetes with glycemic, unspecified, or no complications

I50.9.label: Heart failure, except end-stage and severe

N18.6.label: Chronic kidney disease, stage 5, or end-stage renal disease
